registration_statements: This single-blind, two-arm, parallel-group randomized controlled trial was conducted from March 2022 to March 2023 at the Department of Orthopedic and Rehabilitation Medicine, Faculty of Medicine Siriraj Hospital, Mahidol University, Bangkok, Thailand. The study protocol was approved by the Siriraj Institutional Review Board (COA no.Si-835/2021) and registered with the Thai Clinical Trials Registry ( https://www.thaiclinicaltrials.org/show/TCTR20220123001 ). The study adhered to the principles of the Declaration of Helsinki and its subsequent amendments. Written informed consent was obtained from all participants prior to study initiation. The trial adhered to the Consolidated Standards of Reporting Trials (CONSORT) guidelines for randomized trials.
